## 📝 Pull Request

### 🔗 Related Issue
- Closes #<issue-number>

### 🎯 Summary
Describe the changes introduced by this PR.

### 📸 Screenshots / Demos (UI changes)
If applicable, include before/after or a short GIF.

### ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Runs locally without errors
- [ ] Updated documentation (README/Docs) if needed
- [ ] Added/updated tests where appropriate
- [ ] No sensitive data committed (.env, keys)
- [ ] Accessibility checked (labels, alt text)

### 🔍 Scope of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD or tooling

### 🧪 How to Test
Provide step-by-step testing instructions for reviewers.

### 🧩 Affected Areas
- [ ] Pet Owner Portal (frontend)
- [ ] Professional Portal (doctor interface)
- [ ] Backend API
- [ ] Database/Models
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] E-commerce
- [ ] Appointments
- [ ] Adoption
- [ ] Events
- [ ] Notifications

### 🔐 Security Considerations
Any auth, role, PII, or payment-related impact?

### 💬 Additional Notes
Anything else reviewers should know.
